message:
Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead, I jointly confirm the drive station with you in words as vertical motion at the midspan antinode between the girders below the soffit, where vertical bending motion is largest and falls fast off-centre. In plain words only vertical drive at midspan does full work and moving toward the supports wastes the masses. The off-antinode penalty of 0.75 from the modal effectiveness calculation (E67) and the held 0.476 to 0.526 m/s2 from the detuning sweep (E70) decide it, with the transverse cross-beam layout from the layout sketch (E55).

Bridge Retrofit Engineer, Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor, Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead, tuning need not be exact because the twin Tuned Mass Damper, defined as Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), pair straddles the optimum and damping does the work, not added weight. In plain words a small locked weight shift leaves resonance in the walking band so extra damping must absorb the crowd energy while stroke stays inside the stops. The 800 kg total from the mass-ratio calculation (E13) tuned to 1.83 Hz from the optimum-frequency calculation (E14) at 12.0 percent from the optimum-damping calculation (E15) gives 6.20 percent effective damping with 49.4 mm travel from the free-decay simulation (E17), locked frequency only drops to 1.86 Hz from the locked-frequency check (E69), and 49.4 mm is about a hand width against an 80 mm stop gap.

Manager, the mass versus stroke versus weight tradeoff fits everyday feel and girder space with no deck change. In plain words bare shake is near body weight while damped shake is a small fraction and the added steel is about one person on a crowded deck. The damped 0.67 m/s2 from the crowd build-up simulation (E45) is 0.068 times gravity inside Medium versus bare 8.28 m/s2 from the bare-acceleration calculation (E43) at 0.844 times gravity, and added 7.85 kN from the static-weight calculation (E26) is 1.31 percent from the weight-fraction calculation (E72) of live load, so I am ready because tune tolerance, stroke, station and weight all survive my strongest objection.
